mission_03: Use np.linalg.det() to compute the determinant.
A matrix is invertible if its determinant is not zero.
The determinant of a product equals the product of determinants.
det(A^T) = det(A) — the transpose has the same determinant.
Use a small tolerance (e.g., abs(det) > 1e-10) when checking for zero due to floating-point precision.
